Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and affected scope.

Validation: actual commands/results on this candidate; link relevant evidence.
For large changes, explain why the complete diff is one coherent increment.

Record material limits: unavailable inputs/checks, model or browser acceptance,
and any code/source/contract changes that invalidate earlier evidence.

Confirm confidence-review after code changes and a committed differential or
property test for key-area code (artifact state, provenance, financial
calculations, execution ordering). Docs/config/test-only/generated changes can skip
the latter.
